FROM node:22-bookworm

RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    git ca-certificates curl python3 build-essential \
 && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

WORKDIR /app

# Clone, pin to base commit, strip .git (anti-cheat: agent cannot see fix PR history).

RUN git clone https://github.com/tldraw/tldraw /app \
 && git -C /app checkout 8f498ddb43350989d1741b05a734a0cd4780d46a \
 && rm -rf /app/.git \
 && git -C /app init -q \
 && git -C /app -c user.email=h@l -c user.name=h add -A \
 && git -C /app -c user.email=h@l -c user.name=h commit -q -m base \
 && git -C /app tag harbor_base

# Pre-install workspace dependencies (pinned lockfile)
RUN yarn install --immutable 2>&1 | tail -10 || yarn install 2>&1 | tail -10

# Visual evidence readable by the agent at /app/.harbor_assets/
# tests/ and solution/ are NOT baked in — supplied by the harness at verify time
RUN mkdir -p /logs /app/.harbor_assets
COPY assets/ /app/.harbor_assets/

CMD ["bash"]

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Behavioral verifier for tldraw__tldraw-9133-mm
#
# Applies the test additions, runs vitest jsdom tests in @tldraw/tldraw,
# and computes a reward from the JUnit XML report.
# NEVER greps source for the fix — it runs the tests.
set -uo pipefail
mkdir -p /logs/verifier
STDOUT_LOG=/logs/verifier/test-stdout.txt
STDERR_LOG=/logs/verifier/test-stderr.txt
REPORT=/logs/verifier/report.xml
: > "$STDOUT_LOG"; : > "$STDERR_LOG"

ensure_reward() { [ -f /logs/verifier/reward.txt ] || echo 0 > /logs/verifier/reward.txt; }
trap ensure_reward EXIT

cd /app || { echo "no /app" | tee -a "$STDERR_LOG"; exit 1; }

# ── Reset test files the agent may have touched ─────────────────────────────
# Restore every path mentioned in test.patch to the pristine harbor_base state
# BEFORE applying test.patch, so agent edits to tests cannot affect scoring.
# The agent's source fix (in the non-test files) is preserved.
for _p in $(grep '^+++ b/' /tests/test.patch | sed 's#^+++ b/##'); do
  git checkout harbor_base -- "$_p" 2>/dev/null \
    || rm -f "/app/$_p" 2>/dev/null || true
done
git clean -fdq -- \
  $(grep '^+++ b/' /tests/test.patch | sed 's#^+++ b/##' | xargs -r dirname | sort -u) \
  2>/dev/null || true

echo "== applying test.patch ==" | tee -a "$STDOUT_LOG"
git apply --binary /tests/test.patch 2>>"$STDERR_LOG" \
  || git apply /tests/test.patch 2>>"$STDERR_LOG" \
  || patch -p1 -i /tests/test.patch 2>>"$STDERR_LOG" \
  || { echo "ERROR: could not apply test.patch" | tee -a "$STDERR_LOG"; exit 1; }

echo "== installing pinned test-only deps (none extra; vitest is in the lockfile) ==" \
  | tee -a "$STDOUT_LOG"
# All test dependencies are already in yarn.lock; no extra install step needed.

echo "== running f2p + p2p tests ==" | tee -a "$STDOUT_LOG"
# f2p: "hides the export-as submenu when all export actions are removed"
#      "hides the copy-as submenu when all copy actions are removed"
#      "hides the export-all-as submenu when all export-all actions are removed"
# p2p: "shows the export-as and copy-as submenus by default"
#      "keeps the export-as submenu when at least one export action remains"
#      "shows the export-all-as submenu by default"
#      "keeps the export-all-as submenu when at least one export-all action remains"
#
# All seven tests live in the single ContextMenu.test.tsx file that test.patch appends to
# (the main-menu cases open the main menu dropdown from the same rendered <Tldraw/>).
# We run the whole file; vitest only executes the matched pattern.
cd /app/packages/tldraw
yarn run -T vitest run \
  --reporter=junit --outputFile="$REPORT" \
  "src/test/ui/ContextMenu" \
  >>"$STDOUT_LOG" 2>>"$STDERR_LOG" \
  || echo "(vitest exited non-zero; parsing report anyway)" | tee -a "$STDOUT_LOG"

# Rubric judge — SUB-AGENT backend: no API key, no network. On the first pass there is no
# verdict yet, so judge.py writes a judge request under /logs/verifier/judge/ and prints
# nothing; scoring falls back to tests alone. Once a judge sub-agent has written
# verdict.json there, `mm_run.sh <task> rescore` folds the verdict into the reward.
# The `|| echo ""` is load-bearing: the judge must never be able to fail the run.
RUBRIC=""
if [ -f /tests/rubrics.json ]; then
  RUBRIC=$(python3 /tests/judge.py --rubrics /tests/rubrics.json --repo /app \
             2>/logs/verifier/judge.log || echo "")
  echo "Rubric verdict: ${RUBRIC:-pending (judge request written; rescore after grading)}" \
    | tee -a "$STDOUT_LOG"
fi

echo "== computing reward ==" | tee -a "$STDOUT_LOG"
python3 /tests/verifier.py --rubric "${RUBRIC:-}" 2>>"$STDERR_LOG" | tee -a "$STDOUT_LOG"
echo "reward=$(cat /logs/verifier/reward.txt 2>/dev/null)" | tee -a "$STDOUT_LOG"

2	"""
3	Reward verifier for tldraw__tldraw-9133-mm
4	
5	Parses the JUnit XML produced by vitest and computes a reward:
6	  1.0 — all f2p pass AND all p2p pass
7	  0.0 — otherwise (no partial credit)
8	
9	f2p (fail-to-pass): tests that FAIL on base, PASS after fix.
10	    These directly verify that menu-items.tsx now gates submenus on their actions.
11	p2p (pass-to-pass): tests that PASS on both base and fix.
12	    These guard against regressions (menus that should always show still do).
13	
14	BEHAVIORAL CONTRACT: reward is derived entirely from the test report.
15	This verifier NEVER inspects source code for the fix string or any other token.
16	"""
17	import json, os, re, sys, xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
18	
19	CONF        = json.load(open('/tests/config.json'))
20	F2P         = CONF['f2p']
21	P2P         = CONF['p2p']
22	REPORT      = '/logs/verifier/report.xml'
23	REWARD_OUT  = '/logs/verifier/reward.txt'
24	REWARD_JSON = '/logs/verifier/reward.json'
25	
26	
27	def load_results():
28	    """Return {combined_id: 'pass'|'fail'|'skip'} from the JUnit XML."""
29	    results = {}
30	    if not os.path.exists(REPORT):
31	        return results
32	    try:
33	        tree = ET.parse(REPORT)
34	    except ET.ParseError as exc:
35	        print(f"[verifier] WARNING: could not parse {REPORT}: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
36	        return results
37	    for tc in tree.iter('testcase'):
38	        # Vitest JUnit: classname = describe block(s), name = test title.
39	        # We combine them so substring matching catches both long and short forms.
40	        classname = tc.get('classname', '')
41	        name      = tc.get('name', '')
42	        combined  = f"{classname}::{name}".strip(':')
43	        failed    = any(c.tag in ('failure', 'error') for c in tc)
44	        skipped   = any(c.tag == 'skipped'            for c in tc)
45	        results[combined] = 'skip' if skipped else ('fail' if failed else 'pass')
46	    return results
47	
48	
49	def matched(idents, results):
50	    """Return {ident: 'pass'|'fail'|'skip'|'missing'}.
51	    Matching is substring-first, regex-fallback, to tolerate minor name changes."""
52	    out = {}
53	    for ident in idents:
54	        hit = next(
55	            (v for k, v in results.items()
56	             if ident in k or re.search(re.escape(ident), k)),
57	            None,
58	        )
59	        out[ident] = hit if hit is not None else 'missing'
60	    return out
61	
62	
63	def rubric_verdict(argv):
64	    """The verdict test.sh hands in as `--rubric pass|fail|""`.
65	    Anything that is not an explicit pass/fail — including "" when no rubric ships —
66	    means "not graded", which must never penalise the run."""
67	    if '--rubric' not in argv:
68	        return None
69	    i = argv.index('--rubric')
70	    value = argv[i + 1].strip().lower() if i + 1 < len(argv) else ''
71	    return value if value in ('pass', 'fail') else None
72

74	def write_reward(f2p_bool, p2p_bool, rubric):

76	    (reward, tests_passed, f2p_passed, f2p_total, p2p_passed, p2p_total, rubric_passed),
77	    plus per-test detail riding along as extra scalar f2p::<name>/p2p::<name> keys —
78	    never a nested map. THE POLICY IS BINARY: a strict subset of f2p passing is 0.0,
79	    never partial credit — the count keys already carry how close it got. The rubric
80	    can only ever withhold a 1.0, never push the reward below what the tests earned."""
81	    f2p_passed = sum(1 for v in f2p_bool.values() if v)
82	    p2p_passed = sum(1 for v in p2p_bool.values() if v)
83	    solved = len(F2P) > 0 and f2p_passed == len(F2P) and p2p_passed == len(P2P)
84	    tests_passed = 1.0 if solved else 0.0
85	    reward = 0.0 if rubric == 'fail' else tests_passed
86	
87	    detail = {
88	        'reward': reward,
89	        'tests_passed': tests_passed,
90	        'f2p_passed': f2p_passed, 'f2p_total': len(F2P),
91	        'p2p_passed': p2p_passed, 'p2p_total': len(P2P),
92	        'rubric_passed': {'pass': 1, 'fail': 0}.get(rubric, -1),
93	    }
94	    for k, v in f2p_bool.items():
95	        detail[f'f2p::{k}'] = 1.0 if v else 0.0
96	    for k, v in p2p_bool.items():
97	        detail[f'p2p::{k}'] = 1.0 if v else 0.0

101	        fh.write(str(reward))
102	    try:
103	        with open(REWARD_JSON, 'w') as fh:
104	            json.dump(detail, fh, indent=2)
105	    except Exception as exc:
106	        print(f"WARNING: could not write {REWARD_JSON}: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
107	    print(json.dumps(detail, indent=2))

110	def main():
111	    argv = sys.argv[1:]
112	    rubric = rubric_verdict(argv)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Reward verifier for tldraw__tldraw-9133-mm

Parses the JUnit XML produced by vitest and computes a reward:
  1.0 — all f2p pass AND all p2p pass
  0.0 — otherwise (no partial credit)

f2p (fail-to-pass): tests that FAIL on base, PASS after fix.
    These directly verify that menu-items.tsx now gates submenus on their actions.
p2p (pass-to-pass): tests that PASS on both base and fix.
    These guard against regressions (menus that should always show still do).

BEHAVIORAL CONTRACT: reward is derived entirely from the test report.
This verifier NEVER inspects source code for the fix string or any other token.
"""
import json, os, re, sys, xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

CONF        = json.load(open('/tests/config.json'))
F2P         = CONF['f2p']
P2P         = CONF['p2p']
REPORT      = '/logs/verifier/report.xml'
REWARD_OUT  = '/logs/verifier/reward.txt'
REWARD_JSON = '/logs/verifier/reward.json'


def load_results():
    """Return {combined_id: 'pass'|'fail'|'skip'} from the JUnit XML."""
    results = {}
    if not os.path.exists(REPORT):
        return results
    try:
        tree = ET.parse(REPORT)
    except ET.ParseError as exc:
        print(f"[verifier] WARNING: could not parse {REPORT}: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
        return results
    for tc in tree.iter('testcase'):
        # Vitest JUnit: classname = describe block(s), name = test title.
        # We combine them so substring matching catches both long and short forms.
        classname = tc.get('classname', '')
        name      = tc.get('name', '')
        combined  = f"{classname}::{name}".strip(':')
        failed    = any(c.tag in ('failure', 'error') for c in tc)
        skipped   = any(c.tag == 'skipped'            for c in tc)
        results[combined] = 'skip' if skipped else ('fail' if failed else 'pass')
    return results


def matched(idents, results):
    """Return {ident: 'pass'|'fail'|'skip'|'missing'}.
    Matching is substring-first, regex-fallback, to tolerate minor name changes."""
    out = {}
    for ident in idents:
        hit = next(
            (v for k, v in results.items()
             if ident in k or re.search(re.escape(ident), k)),
            None,
        )
        out[ident] = hit if hit is not None else 'missing'
    return out


def rubric_verdict(argv):
    """The verdict test.sh hands in as `--rubric pass|fail|""`.
    Anything that is not an explicit pass/fail — including "" when no rubric ships —
    means "not graded", which must never penalise the run."""
    if '--rubric' not in argv:
        return None
    i = argv.index('--rubric')
    value = argv[i + 1].strip().lower() if i + 1 < len(argv) else ''
    return value if value in ('pass', 'fail') else None


def write_reward(f2p_bool, p2p_bool, rubric):
    """reward.json is a FLAT map of numbers, exactly the seven canonical keys
    (reward, tests_passed, f2p_passed, f2p_total, p2p_passed, p2p_total, rubric_passed),
    plus per-test detail riding along as extra scalar f2p::<name>/p2p::<name> keys —
    never a nested map. THE POLICY IS BINARY: a strict subset of f2p passing is 0.0,
    never partial credit — the count keys already carry how close it got. The rubric
    can only ever withhold a 1.0, never push the reward below what the tests earned."""
    f2p_passed = sum(1 for v in f2p_bool.values() if v)
    p2p_passed = sum(1 for v in p2p_bool.values() if v)
    solved = len(F2P) > 0 and f2p_passed == len(F2P) and p2p_passed == len(P2P)
    tests_passed = 1.0 if solved else 0.0
    reward = 0.0 if rubric == 'fail' else tests_passed

    detail = {
        'reward': reward,
        'tests_passed': tests_passed,
        'f2p_passed': f2p_passed, 'f2p_total': len(F2P),
        'p2p_passed': p2p_passed, 'p2p_total': len(P2P),
        'rubric_passed': {'pass': 1, 'fail': 0}.get(rubric, -1),
    }
    for k, v in f2p_bool.items():
        detail[f'f2p::{k}'] = 1.0 if v else 0.0
    for k, v in p2p_bool.items():
        detail[f'p2p::{k}'] = 1.0 if v else 0.0

    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(REWARD_OUT), exist_ok=True)
    with open(REWARD_OUT, 'w') as fh:
        fh.write(str(reward))
    try:
        with open(REWARD_JSON, 'w') as fh:
            json.dump(detail, fh, indent=2)
    except Exception as exc:
        print(f"WARNING: could not write {REWARD_JSON}: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
    print(json.dumps(detail, indent=2))


def main():
    argv = sys.argv[1:]
    rubric = rubric_verdict(argv)

    r   = load_results()
    f2p = matched(F2P, r)
    p2p = matched(P2P, r)

    # Each test is graded individually so the map, not just the aggregate, shows which passed.
    f2p_bool = {k: v == 'pass' for k, v in f2p.items()}
    p2p_bool = {k: v == 'pass' for k, v in p2p.items()}

    write_reward(f2p_bool, p2p_bool, rubric)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
